title: fix(app-shell): both Create View doors build the persisted view through one builder, so "Save as view" saves a kanban the spec accepts (objectui#11581)
body:
Fixes #11581

Clause-②: no
Why no: the new symbols (`buildNewViewSpec` in the new `packages/app-shell/src/views/newViewSpec.ts`, `buildAddViewSpec` in `ObjectView.tsx`, `offeredViewTypes` in `CreateViewDialog.tsx`) are module exports for the pins only. Nothing is added to `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` (the package exports only `.`), and `views/index.ts` re-exports `CreateViewDialog` and `ObjectView` by name, not these.

## What changed

The Create View dialog persists through two doors: "Save as view" on the object data page, and the add-view door on the object page (`handleViewCreate`: the tab bar's add button and the view-config panel's create mode). They assembled the spec separately from the same payload, and only the add-view door mirrored the columns into `kanban.columns` / `gallery.visibleFields`. Measured on the cut (`f1c9379`) with the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.6.0: "Save as view" with Kanban is refused, `invalid_type` at `kanban.columns`; every other offered type parses at both doors, but a gallery from "Save as view" carries no `visibleFields` while the same payload through the tab bar does.

- **One builder:** `buildNewViewSpec(config, { fallbackColumns, filter })`. It resolves `columns` (the payload's, else the door's fallback), places `filter` (no rules, no key), and owns every type-specific rule through `COLUMN_MIRRORS`, a TOTAL record over `ListViewVisualization`: `kanban` (required `columns`), `gallery` (`visibleFields` when the payload has none), `null` for the other seven, so a new visualization fails the build until its block is decided.
- **Door 1** `buildSaveAsViewSpec(config, columns, urlFilters)` keeps its signature and pins; it now resolves only its inputs (page columns, URL triples folded to spec rules) and calls the builder.
- **Door 2** `handleViewCreate`'s inline body moves to `buildAddViewSpec(config, objectDef)`, which supplies `defaultListColumnsFromObject(objectDef, 5)` and calls the builder. This door's body is byte-identical to before.
- `CreateViewDialog.offeredViewTypes()`: a pure read of the picker's rows (`buildViewTypeMeta` with an identity translator), so the pin enumerates at collection time.
- Behaviour change, "Save as view" only: a kanban now persists `kanban.columns` (was a 422 at the view write door); a gallery now persists `gallery.visibleFields` = the view's columns when it declares none, as the tab-bar door always did, so its cards show those fields.
- objectui#11578's refusal toasts and the dialog's await, and objectui#11576's chart dataset binding, are unchanged. The other write sites objectui#11583 lists are not touched.
- One `@object-ui/app-shell` patch changeset: `.changeset/11581-one-view-builder.md`.

## Pins

- `CreateViewDialog.viewTypeParse-11581.test.tsx`
  - enumeration: `PARSE_ROWS` names exactly `offeredViewTypes()`, and `offeredViewTypes()` is the type grid the dialog renders;
  - one row per offered type (`it.each(offeredViewTypes())`): the real dialog is rendered and submitted with that row's picks, the payload goes through `buildSaveAsViewSpec` and `buildAddViewSpec`, each wrapped by `viewEnvelope`; `ListViewSchema` must accept the envelope's `config` and `ViewItemSchema` the envelope, at both doors (soft, so a row names every refusing door), and the two doors must build the same envelope from the same columns;
  - the builder's mirror pins (`kanban.columns`, `gallery.visibleFields` kept when declared, nothing for other types or a prototype-chain name);
  - "Save as view" with Kanban through `ObjectDataPage`, against the spec's view gate replayed at the network boundary: 200, `kanban.columns` equal to the persisted `columns`, lands on the draft.
- `ObjectView.createKanbanView-11581.test.tsx`: the add-view door through the real `ObjectView` and dialog; the saved body parses and carries the mirror.

## Evidence

- **Red before** (`1a8dc9a`, the pin plus door 2 moved unchanged into `buildAddViewSpec`, no builder): 3 failed, 10 passed. Kanban row: DOOR 1 refused, `invalid_type` at `kanban.columns`. Gallery row: "the two doors built different bodies from one payload". Page case: `expected 422 to be 200`.
- **Green after** at `168f819`: the new file 17 passed; the door-2 page pin 1 passed.
- **Ablation 1**, the kanban mirror set to `null` in the builder (anchor 1 to 0, injection 0 to 1, on disk): 5 failed, 13 passed. The kanban row fails at BOTH doors, both schemas (`kanban.columns` / `config.kanban.columns`, "expected array, received undefined"); both builder kanban pins; both page cases. Restored with `git checkout HEAD`; blob `accf26f1db91` equals the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Ablation 2**, a fake type appended to `buildViewTypeMeta`'s record (injection 0 to 1 on disk): 2 failed, 16 passed: the `PARSE_ROWS` enumeration and the row `fake_ablation_type` ("no parse row for the offered view type"). The rendered-grid check stays green, since the grid and `offeredViewTypes()` both carry it. Restored; blob `aa96b493d04b` equals the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Gates (head `168f819`)

- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build` (29 packages): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, which includes `src/**/*.test.tsx`): exit 0.
- vitest, narrowed: the 75 test files that import a changed module by name (`git grep` for `ObjectView`, `ObjectDataPage`, `CreateViewDialog`, `runtime-metadata-persistence`, `newViewSpec` across `packages/**` and `apps/**` tests, minus the 46 hits in `packages/plugin-view`, which import that package's own `ObjectView`): 75 files, 857 tests passed. It includes every `CreateViewDialog.*`, `ObjectDataPage.*` and `ObjectView.create*` suite.
- eslint on the 7 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files, `--no-inline-config --format json`: 7 files, 0 errors. The narrowing is a measurement: the population is the config's `**/*.{ts,tsx}` rule objects; the rule set is `tseslint.configs.recommended` with no type-aware parser options, and no `eslint-rules/*` rule reads another file, so the diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:changeset-claims` (2 pending bodies name `ObjectView.tsx` / `ObjectDataPage.tsx`; both re-read and still true), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:self-import`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-governed-queue-guard --test` (NOT GOVERNED): all exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED: the whole `packages/app-shell` suite (988 test files). One run died with its process, without a verdict, about 20 minutes in, at `--maxWorkers=2`; CI's `pnpm test` runs it. `check:eager-closure`: PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it reads a built console bundle); CI owns it.

## Acceptance notes

- The `grid` type card's test id, `create-view-type-grid`, is also the test id of the grid that holds the cards. The new pin reads cards by tag. No user effect; noted, not filed (carrier: none).
- The dialog's key pattern accepts a one-character key, while the spec `ListViewSchema` `name` needs two. Not reachable as a refusal: `viewEnvelope` strips `name` from `config`, and the envelope's `name` is the qualified object-dot-key, which `ViewItemSchema` accepts (measured with a one-character key). Observation only.
- `origin/main` moved to `0c012a7` after the cut (objectui#10872's README, objectui#11511's skills guide). Neither touches these files, so the branch is not merged with it.
